title: Finding
description: The unit of knowledge exchanged between agents: one number-backed statement with provenance, importance and confidence. Published by analysis agents, ranked by the Strategy agent, cited by the report and verified by the Critic.

id.description: Stable reference, area prefix + two digits (DAT, MAC, MKT, CMP, CON, SEG, FCT).

statement.description: One sentence with the numbers that support it.

metrics.description: Machine-readable values behind the statement; the Critic uses them as evidence numbers.

evidence.description: Datasets, methods or artefacts the finding was derived from.

swot.description: SWOT quadrant from the client's point of view; null for methodology findings.

priority.description: Derived: impact x confidence (present in saved runs).
